Etymology tree
Sanskrit चन्दन (candana)der.
Middle Persian cndlbor.
Arabic صَنْدَل (ṣandal)der.
Arabic صيدلة
Derived from صَنْدَل (ṣandal, “sandalwood”), borrowed from Middle Persian cndl, from Sanskrit चन्दन (candana). Originally indicating the profession of selling sandalwood.
